name: v3
description: Entries with the trend of a higher timeframe, stop and target in units of volatility, and an optional bounded ladder: at most two equal-sized adds, released by a price step, an RSI cross-back, a MACD turn or (adding to a winner) a step in profit. max_adds 0 is the same design without a ladder, so the search itself says whether a ladder earns its risk.

trend_tf.note: entries only in the direction of this timeframe's trend (sign of its MACD signal line on the last closed bar)

entry_agree_s.note: 2 = the live rule: both M15 votes must agree with the entry; 0 = the OPEN score alone decides

target_vol.note: basket target per unit, in H1 volatility units (gold: about 6 to 15 USD each in 2025-26; BTC: about 2 to 3)

stop_vol.note: basket stop per unit, in the same units

vol_cap_usd_per_unit.note: ceiling on what one volatility unit may be worth, USD per unit; 0 = none (it never binds on BTC at these prices)

max_adds.note: equal-sized ladder adds allowed after the entry

ladder_trigger.note: what releases an add: distance alone, the tier RSI coming back from beyond 35 / 65, the tier MACD vote turning with the basket, or (profit_step) price moving in the basket's favour

ladder_gap_vol.note: least distance between fills, in volatility units (for the two step triggers it is the step)

trail_gap_vol.note: trailing exit: close when the basket has given back this much from its best, in volatility units; 0 = no trailing

trail_start_vol.note: the trailing exit is armed once the basket has been this far in profit

loss_cooldown_s.note: pause after a losing basket, seconds

max_hold_s.note: close a basket that has been open this long, seconds; 0 = no time stop
